slides.title: Most Cyber Pros Never Negotiate Salary
slides.subtitle: It costs them $18K a year

bullets: Know your market rate before every interview
Get a competing offer - even if you won't take it
Silence is a tool. Let them go first.
Ask once, clearly, then hold your ground

caption: The candidate who negotiates starts $18K ahead. Same role. Same skills. Just one conversation. Know your worth. #cybersecurity #cybersecuritycareers #salarynegotiation #cypherjobs #careertips
